3239.title: Outbound provider requests bypass environment HTTP proxies
3239.rootCauseOneLine: bb-owned provider and server request paths call Node's default fetch without a proxy-aware dispatcher, including inside a separately forked plugin-host process.
3239.proposedFix: Install one owned EnvHttpProxyAgent-based dispatcher before request code loads in the server and each forked host/plugin process, with HTTP_PROXY and NO_PROXY regression coverage for both process boundaries.
3239.caveats: The credentialed upstream HTTP 403 responses were not replayed. The deterministic local routing defect was reproduced twice without external network access or credentials.
